name: Jiangsu Riying Electronics Co.,Ltd.
summary: Jiangsu Riying Electronics Co.,Ltd. engages in the research, development, production, and sale of automotive parts, motorcycle and balance scooter parts, and smart home sensors in China and internationally. The company offers sensing products, such as temperature, temperature and humidity, PM2.5, rainfall, light, seat position, and camera; and transmission products, including harnesses, microswitch, connecting wire, crimp connector, board-to-board connector, connector terminal, and connector housing.
